title: Yarn lockfile resolves a package from a git remote
description: yarn.lock declares a Yarn resolution that names a git remote instead of a registry range. The code sits outside the registry's publication controls, so its advisory linkage and provenance are unknown.
remediation: Depend on a published version that the registry serves with a checksum.
limitation: It matches a Yarn resolution that names a git remote instead of a registry range in the parsed yarn.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
